cards.card_text: From there until the Messiah, the Prince, he counts seven weeks and sixty-two weeks.
cards.verse_text: Know and understand this: From the issuance of the decree to restore and rebuild Jerusalem until the Messiah, the Prince, there will be seven weeks and sixty-two weeks.
cards.snippet: …the issuance of the decree to restore and rebuild Jerusalem until the Messiah, the Prince, there will be seven weeks and sixty-two weeks.

cards.card_text: Gabriel goes on: "Then after the sixty-two weeks the Messiah will be cut off and will have nothing." Next, he says, the people of the prince who is to come will destroy the city and the sanctuary, and the end will come like a flood.
cards.verse_text: Then after the sixty-two weeks the Messiah will be cut off and will have nothing.
cards.snippet: Then after the sixty-two weeks the Messiah will be cut off and will have nothing.

cards.card_text: Andrew tells Simon, "We have found the Messiah" (which is translated as Christ).
cards.verse_text: He first found his brother Simon and told him, “We have found the Messiah” (which is translated as Christ).
cards.snippet: …first found his brother Simon and told him, “We have found the Messiah” (which is translated as Christ).

cards.card_text: The woman says she knows the Messiah, called Christ, is coming, and when He comes, He will explain everything.
cards.verse_text: The woman said, “I know that Messiah” (called Christ) “is coming.
cards.snippet: The woman said, “I know that Messiah” (called Christ) “is coming.
